commander.style: Calm, firm male tactical squad leader in freezing arctic wind, low radio grit, crisp authority under fire.

engineer.style: Dry, technical male field engineer, freezing and practical, steady matter-of-fact cadence.

medic_sapper.style: Tired, warm male tactical medic and sapper, controlled care and quiet grit in bitter cold.

pmc_op_1.style: Hardened male hostile PMC rifleman in freezing wind, terse gritty combat callout.

pmc_op_2.style: Cold professional male PMC mercenary, firm clipped radio discipline.

pmc_op_3.style: Alert male PMC point man, clear urgent tactical warning.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Calm, firm, crisp male warning callout on sight of hostiles.
lines.text: Contact!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Calm, firm male tactical order under sudden ambush.
lines.text: Ambush! Hostiles on the level - eliminate them!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Firm male tactical warning over cold wind, bracing the squad.
lines.text: Wave 1: enemies advancing!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Measured, calm, disciplined male radio briefing tone.
lines.text: Autonomy ON. Operatives hold positions within 7 m of the order point.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Calm, firm male radio confirmation switching to manual lead.
lines.text: Autonomy OFF. Full manual control.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Calm, crisp male squad acknowledgment releasing pause.
lines.text: Orders received! Moving out!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Firm, authoritative male fire-control command over gunfire.
lines.text: Suppressive fire! Keep their heads down!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Firm, relieved male grit as diesel machinery finally turns over.
lines.text: Pouring in the diesel and pulling the starter... The generator roars to life!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Calm, firm male extraction order into radio.
lines.text: The blast door is wide open - that's our way out. Everybody through!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Firm, steady male callout pulling the squad back together.
lines.text: Solo range exceeded! Teammates, regroup!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Urgent, strained male voice under heavy enemy pressure.
lines.text: Fall back, fall back! They'll overrun us!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry, technical male field engineer confirming power restoration in freezing air.
lines.text: Generator restored! All turrets are powered!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact male field engineer report after a wave.
lines.text: Surviving fortifications dismantled and returned to the gear.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry, technical male diagnosis after inspecting broken equipment in subzero cold.
lines.text: The backup generator is intact, but the tank is dry. It needs diesel fuel.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry, focused male technical update transferring fuel.
lines.text: Draining the remaining diesel from the APC fuel system... canister is full!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry, practical male scavenging callout.
lines.text: Found an empty 20L Fuel Canister. Now we have something to drain the fuel into.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry, technical male combat check at wall edge.
lines.text: At the corner - covering it!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Steady, dry male tactical report from high cover.
lines.text: Hugging the wall, holding the corner!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Brief, dry male position callout behind low cover.
lines.text: Behind cover!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Quick, practical male movement callout.
lines.text: Take cover!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Focused, terse male callout crossing between cover walls.
lines.text: Dash to the other cover!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Technical, calm male callout shimmying around a corner.
lines.text: Along the wall, round the corner.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry, steady male confirmation holding sector.
lines.text: Guard point set! Holding the sector.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry, brisk male acknowledgment rejoining formation.
lines.text: Off guard, regrouping!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Clipped, dry male warning while swapping shotgun/rifle mag.
lines.text: Mag empty! Cover the sector!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Technical male squad callout stacking at wall corner.
lines.text: Covering the corner - the squad stacks up behind me.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Fierce, gritty male adrenaline shout in combat.
lines.text: Hold the line! Tear through them!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Tired, warm male tactical medic-sapper, controlled sharp warning to protect teammates.
lines.text: Tripwire! Wire at shin height - everyone hold position!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Tired, warm male analytical field check on an abandoned vehicle.
lines.text: The abandoned vehicle's tank still holds diesel, but there is nothing to drain it into.

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Tired, steady male combat callout over gunfire.
lines.text: Reloading! Cover me!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Controlled, tired male callout swapping magazine.
lines.text: Reloading! Watch my back!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Warm protective urgency, tired male shout warning teammates to duck.
lines.text: Grenade out! Get down!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Low urgent male warning throwing explosive.
lines.text: Grenade away! Heads down!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Tired, calm warm male breath in cover, watching the sector.
lines.text: In cover, holding the sector!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Tired, steady warm male report behind sandbag barricade.
lines.text: Behind the barricade, ready to fight!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Tired, warm reassuring male medic report after field dressing.
lines.text: Patched up - ready to stand again.

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Exhausted, warm relieved male sigh recovering from frostbite.
lines.text: I can feel my legs again... I can move!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Wounded, tired, strained male call for field aid.
lines.text: Critically wounded - going down, need a patch!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Tired, appreciative warm male report scavenging supplies.
lines.text: Took supplies from the supply crate!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Tired, warm steady male voice regaining composure.
lines.text: Got a grip! Back in formation!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_1
lines.style: Hardened male hostile PMC rifleman shouting from low cover.
lines.text: Behind cover!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_1
lines.style: Gritty male PMC operator stacking on wall edge.
lines.text: Hugging the wall, holding the corner!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_1
lines.style: Terse male PMC rifleman under fire.
lines.text: Reloading! Cover me!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_2
lines.style: Cold professional male PMC mercenary calling cover.
lines.text: Behind cover!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_2
lines.style: Firm, cold male PMC operator holding high-wall corner.
lines.text: Hugging the wall, holding the corner!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_2
lines.style: Controlled cold male PMC callout swapping magazine.
lines.text: Changing mags, hold them off!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_3
lines.style: Sharp male PMC point man peeking corner.
lines.text: At the corner - covering it!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_3
lines.style: Clear alert male PMC operator watching sector from cover.
lines.text: In cover, holding the sector!

lines.speaker: pmc_op_3
lines.style: Urgent male PMC throw warning.
lines.text: Grenade out! Get down!
